title: Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine
description:
Overview

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine at Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC). Reports To: Chief Medical Officer. FLSA Status: Exempt. Wage Range: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly.

Summary: Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results, the Physician provides primary healthcare services for CHC and performs related work as required. CHC aims to provide the highest quality of total care to the patient population; employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities
  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.
  • Perform physical assessments and discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.
  • Provide routine physical examinations, diagnostic services, and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and assure quality of care for all patients.
  • Share on-call duties with other medical staff as indicated.
  • Elicit and record information about patient medical history; examine patients to determine general physical condition.
  • Order or execute tests, analyses, and diagnostic images; analyze reports and findings to diagnose conditions.
  • Administer or prescribe treatments and drugs; inoculate and vaccinate patients; advise on diet, hygiene, and disease prevention.
  • Report births, deaths, and outbreaks to governmental authorities; refer patients to specialists when needed.
  • Perform minor surgeries and conduct physicals for school admissions, job considerations, or insurance eligibility.
  • Assist the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies and education programs; participate in care coordination and policy development as required.
  • Share supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required; work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested; adhere to safety and infection control policies; provide age-appropriate care across patient populations.
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant, confidential communications; participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.
  • Coordinate with the Care Team to arrange appropriate services and support patient goals; contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.
Supervisory Responsibilities

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Qualifications
  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Completion in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN, or Pediatrics; board certified or board eligible.
  • Licenses and Certifications: Current, unrestricted Physician and Surgeon license in California; current DEA license; ACLS for FP/IM; PALS for Pediatrics; BLS (all specialties).
  • Continuing education: Maintains current knowledge through CME and participation in relevant medical societies.
  • Language Skills: English required; Spanish bilingual desirable.
Education And/or Experience

As listed under Qualifications above.

Other Requirements
  • Ability to perform essential duties and accommodate reasonable accommodations as needed.
  • Physical demands and work environment as described below may apply: willing to work flexible hours, occasional travel to other clinic sites.

Note: This job description contains general information and is not an exhaustive listing of duties and responsibilities. EEO statements and other legally required notices remain in effect.

No Fairmont Rio de Janeiro Copacabana você viverá uma experiência única e incomparável durante sua hospedagem em Copacabana, seja a passeio ou a trabalho. title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição no Rio de Janeiro, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O/a Gerente de Projeto atuará como responsável pela gestão do ciclo relativo à execução de projeto no Rio de Janeiro, com uma abordagem integrada relativa aos aspectos ligados a implementação e administração. Sua principal função é desenvolver o projeto de acordo com o tempo, prazo, escopo e conteúdo estabelecido junto com Cliente administrando equipe e recurso para tal escopo. Será o representante da AVSI junto a CONTRATANTE e responderá diretamente à Gerência Geral do RJ.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI;
  2. Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos;
  3. Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa;
  4. Monitorar periodicamente os aspectos operacionais e administrativos do programa, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto;
  5. Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos;
  6. Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público-alvo;
  7. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer as ações do programa, sempre que necessário;
  8. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas;
  9. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições;
  10. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa;
  11. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI;
  12. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante;
  13. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário;
  14. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente;
  15. Garantir uma presença fixa e estável na área de atuação do programa;
  16. Enviar periodicamente informações para o setor de Comunicação da AVSI para divulgação de matérias ou notícias nos canais institucionais da organização;
  17. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto;
  18. Manter atualizadas as informações de Patrimonialização, a respeito do(s) projeto(s) que estão sob sua responsabilidade;
  19. Enviar mensalmente ao setor Financeiro as provisões de contas a pagar do projeto, contribuindo para a atualização contínua do fluxo de caixa da Organização;
  20. Acompanhar e monitorar o envio dos relatórios dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  21. Implementar, acompanhar e monitorar os KPI`s do serviço (gestão a vista);
  22. Produzir apresentações mensais com dados gerais do projeto;
  23. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário;
  24. Definir critérios, procedimentos e acompanhar as atividades desenvolvidas no setor, buscando melhoria contínua dos processos em que atua, revisando e criticando os procedimentos internos;
  25. Acompanhar a adaptação dos novos liderados diretos no período da experiência, avaliando e dando feedback de desempenho, verificando sua aderência ao esperado para o cargo;
  26. Treinar e capacitar os liderados diretos, acompanhando a rotina e desempenho da equipe constantemente;
  27. Elaborar e acompanhar o planejamento de férias da equipe em cumprimento das diretrizes;
  28. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do Projeto.

title: SUPERVISOR DE CORTE
description:
Para você que se identifica e gosta de moda: a ViX Paula Hermanny está procurando um supervisor de corte que será responsável por realizar o acompanhamento das peças a serem cortadas de acordo com o risco e ordem de corte, controle dos modelos e datas de saída de cada pedido, solicitação material e conferência.

Principais atividades:

  1. Planejamento e Organização do Corte
    • Organizar a programação de corte de acordo com a demanda de produção.
    • Definir os materiais e insumos necessários para cada lote de produção.
    • Planejar a sequência de cortes, levando em consideração a otimização do uso de tecido e o aproveitamento máximo do material disponível.
  2. Gestão de Equipe
    • Supervisionar a equipe de corte, garantindo que todos os colaboradores cumpram os padrões e procedimentos estabelecidos.
    • Treinar novos colaboradores e promover o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe.
    • Realizar a gestão de turnos, escalas e garantir a disciplina e motivação da equipe.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Garantir que os cortes sejam realizados com precisão, seguindo os moldes e especificações do design.
    • Identificar e corrigir problemas de qualidade no corte, como falhas nos moldes ou irregularidades no tecido.
    • Realizar inspeções regulares para verificar a conformidade com as normas de qualidade estabelecidas pela empresa.
  4. Acompanhamento de Produção
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção e verificar se o cronograma de corte está sendo cumprido.
    • Resolver eventuais problemas que possam surgir durante o processo, como falta de material, erro no corte, ou necessidade de ajustes no molde.
    • Realizar a comunicação constante com outros setores, como modelagem, produção e acabamento, para garantir a fluidez do processo.
  5. Gestão de Materiais e Recursos
    • Controlar o estoque de tecidos, garantir o uso adequado dos materiais e evitar desperdícios.
    • Acompanhar a manutenção e conservação das máquinas de corte.
    • Identificar a necessidade de reposição de materiais e insumos e realizar os pedidos de reposição.
  6. Relatórios e Acompanhamento de Resultados
    • Gerar relatórios periódicos sobre a produtividade, desperdícios e eficiência do processo de corte.
    • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e sugerir melhorias para otimização do processo.
    • Garantir que os custos com o processo de corte estejam dentro do orçamento estabelecido.
  7. Segurança e Normas
    • Garantir que os procedimentos de segurança sejam seguidos, minimizando riscos de acidentes durante o processo de corte.
    • Cumprir com as normas ambientais, de saúde e segurança no trabalho, implementando ações de prevenção de acidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  1. Ensino médio completo.
  2. Liderança e capacidade de gerenciamento de equipes;
  3. Conhecimento técnico sobre o processo de corte, tipos de tecidos e materiais.
  4. Habilidade para trabalhar com sistemas de controle de produção e relatórios.
  5. Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de solucionar problemas rapidamente.
  6. Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros departamentos.

Local de trabalho: São Cristóvão - RJ, 100% presencial.

  • Resourceful, proactive, and excited to build in a global, fast-moving startup environment.

If you\’re passionate about compliance, crypto, and building the future of payments in Brazil, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to join us at Conduit and help shape the future of cross-border finance.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Executive Operations Director role at FIFA Women's World Cup

Location: Brazil

Description

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the biggest female sporting event in the world, the pinnacle of women’s football globally and the main showcase for our sport, our athletes, our Member Associations, and our fans. FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Position

The Executive Operations Director, under the guidance of the Executive Tournament Director and in close collaboration with the Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup, is responsible for the successful operational delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and all related events in accordance with the comprehensive project plan. This includes ensuring the appropriate hosting conditions are provided in collaboration with the host cities, stadium and venue owners, local authorities and third-party entities.

Key Responsibilities
  • Leadership & Team Management:
    • Lead and manage the operations team, working closely with all key stakeholders (FIFA Zurich, state and federal government where necessary, host cities, commercial partners, etc.).
    • Ensure effective collaboration between all departments and individuals involved in the tournament's operations.
    • Provide strategic guidance and decision-making during the tournament planning and execution phases.
    • Specifically, the Executive Operations Director shall be responsible for the key operational departments within FIFA27 Brazil, including: Venue Operations, Competitions & Team Services, Safety, security, accreditation & access control, Technology, Events & Entertainment, Medical, Technical Services / Infrastructure, Broadcast and media, Event Services (such as transportation, logistics, travel and accommodation).
  • Operational Planning & Execution:
    • Oversee the operational execution of the FIFA Women’s World Cup, covering all tournament venues, from logistics and planning through to match-day operations.
    • Implement and oversee operational plans, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s goals, budgets, and timelines.
    • Coordinate various functional areas to ensure seamless operations at all venues.
    • Manage the operational budget, ensuring resources are allocated efficiently across all functional areas.
    • Report on financial performance and provide operational cost optimization strategies.
Your Profile
  • Extensive Experience in Major Sports Events:
    • At least 8-10 years of experience in managing operations for large-scale sports events (e.g. World Cup, Olympic Games, continental championships, etc.).
    • Proven track record of managing cross-functional teams for international sporting events, with an emphasis on logistics, venue management, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Leadership & Management:
    • Strong experience in leading large teams, with the ability to manage diverse and high-performing teams.
    • Previous experience in a senior management role with decision-making authority.
    • Ability to work in high-pressure environments and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Operational Expertise:
    • In-depth knowledge of operational best practices in international sports events, including logistics, security, transportation, and venue operations.
    • Experience managing logistics for major international sporting events, including team operations, transport, logistics, goods delivery.
  • Knowledge of Sports Governance and Regulations:
    • Strong understanding of FIFA regulations, tournament operations, and the international sports governance landscape.
    • Knowledge of the compliance and safety standards required for international events.
  • Crisis Management & Problem Solving:
    • Strong crisis management skills with a proven ability to handle unforeseen challenges during large-scale events.
    • Ability to think quickly and implement solutions under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Management:
    • Proven ability to manage substantial operational budgets and resources.
    • Experience in cost control, optimizing event operations within budget constraints.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
    • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
    • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including sponsors, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
    • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
    • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian) with proficiency in additional languages (e.g., Spanish, French) preferred.

  • Análise de Dados para Geração de Insights: realizar análises de dados abrangentes, desde solicitações ad-hoc simples até investigações de alta complexidade, para identificar tendências, padrões e insights acionáveis relevantes para os objetivos de negócios da DPGP.

  • Comunicar os insights de dados de forma eficaz para diversas audiências, incluindo stakeholders não técnicos, por meio de apresentações envolventes e storytelling visual.
  • Otimização de Processos e Automação: identificar oportunidades para otimizar processos de dados, automatizar relatórios e aprimorar as capacidades de tomada de decisão baseadas em dados dentro da divisão.

Descrição Do Trabalho

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Coletar, analisar e interpretar dados para fornecer insights estratégicos que apoiem a tomada de decisão em todos os níveis da empresa. Atuar na evolução da cultura de dados, garantindo a criação de análises robustas e painéis de controle estratégicos. Trabalhar em colaboração com diferentes áreas para garantir que os dados sejam precisos, confiáveis e transformados em insights acionáveis.

  • Coletar, processar e analisar dados de múltiplas fontes, garantindo a integridade e confiabilidade das informações;
  • Desenvolver modelos de análise de dados para identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos internos e estratégicos;
  • Construir e manter painéis de controle e relatórios gerenciais que apresentem insights relevantes para a empresa;
  • Monitorar e interpretar métricas-chave de desempenho (KPIs), transformando dados brutos em insights acionáveis;
  • Aplicar técnicas avançadas de análise de dados, incluindo modelagem preditiva, séries temporais, machine learning e mineração de dados;

  • Criar documentação e padronizar processos para governança e qualidade de dados.

  • Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas e técnicas de manipulação e modelagem de dados: SQL (imprescindível), ETL;

  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização de dados: Looker e Tableau (preferencialmente) ou similares;
  • Experiência com ambientes de computação em nuvem: GCP (preferencial), Azure ou AWS;
  • Autonomia para propor e executar soluções, buscando melhorias nos produtos de dados;
  • Organização, autonomia e priorização, com boa capacidade de comunicação e negociação com áreas de negócios;

  • Alta capacidade analítica e habilidade de storytelling para criação de materiais técnicos e de negócio;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e entendimento de governança de dados.

title: Accounting Manager Avp
description:
Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.

The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

description:
Overview

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

REMOTE | LATAM

Property Leads is a fast-growing startup building cutting-edge lead generation and data solutions for the real estate industry. We're a lean, high-impact team of 16, solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, data, and growth.

We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to take a lead role in shaping our engineering strategy while staying close to the code. This role is hands-on and high-leverage — ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys deep technical ownership, and wants to directly influence the trajectory of a product and company.

You’ll work closely with the executive team to scale our technology, grow our team, and help define the next chapter of our platform.

Role

Principal Software Engineer to take a lead role in shaping our engineering strategy while staying close to the code. This role is hands-on and high-leverage.

Responsibilities
  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of critical systems with high impact across multiple teams.
  • Drive technical strategy and set engineering standards for scalability, performance, security, and reliability.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and business to influence product direction.
  • Recognize how software and systems engineering drive revenue and reduce costs, and use that lens to prioritize initiatives based on business impact.
  • Hire and mentor senior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, design sessions, and informal coaching.
  • Dive deep into the code, especially in high-stakes systems (distributed systems, high-throughput APIs, low-latency pipelines).
  • Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies that can create meaningful leverage.
  • Brainstorm with the executive team on new initiatives from a software perspective.
Requirements
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 2+ years in a principal role.
  • Proven ability to drive complex technical projects from 0 to production.
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, data platforms, backend APIs, cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong architectural skills and a pragmatic approach to design tradeoffs.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and aligning cross-team stakeholders.
  • Empathetic leadership and the ability to build trust across teams.
  • Proficiency in Python, AWS Lambda, MongoDB, ML/AI — but more importantly, fluency in core engineering principles.
  • Highly motivated and detail-oriented with a proven track record navigating a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Results

In your first 6–12 months, success looks like:

  • Reduced errors and downtime to near 0 in production.
  • Led the redesign and major scaling effort of our core lead distribution system, improving performance and reliability.
  • Shipped key infrastructure and product features that unlocked growth and operational efficiency amongst the sales and marketing teams.
  • Established engineering standards across testing, deployment, and code quality.
  • Mentored engineers and helped elevate the overall technical maturity of the team.
  • Played a critical role in hiring and onboarding new technical talent.
  • Introduced tools, workflows, and frameworks that made development faster and more predictable.
  • Built strong partnerships with the executive team and other leaders across the company, helping influence company strategy through a technical lens.
Salary
  • Competitive base salary
  • Bonus: Up to 25%, performance-based
Benefits
  • Competitive total compensation
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid Sick Time
  • Flexible work schedule

description:

Department: Legal (DEPT_LGL)

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

We are #EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for checking the accuracy of import/export recordkeeping.
  • Manage, request, and compile necessary import documentation to ensure entry accuracy.
  • Partner with different teams like sales and customer services teams on due diligence process, including but not limited to Know your customer, screening, and vetting.
  • Support local entity’s participation on FTA (Free trade agreement) under the guidance from Corp. compliance and partner with functional teams on the necessary supporting calculation and collection.
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure accurate Harmonized Tariff classifications, maintain internal classification databases and ensure accuracy of customs entries.
  • Assist in maintaining part databases with global trade compliance data including product classifications, HTS Codes, and country of origin classifications.
  • Audit Import entry data and manage any Post Entry Amendment requirements with the broker.
  • Coordinate audits to ensure import/export policies are followed and identify necessary corrective action plans to continuous improvement.
  • Manage the proper reporting of assists as related to Dover trade compliance policy.
  • Provide training with the support from corporate compliance team to local entities on different trade compliance topic.
  • General compliance support, including VC (screening tool), TPG (3rdparty vetting platform), code of conduct, conflict of interest, training etc.
  • Other duties pertaining to corporate compliance as assigned.

Qualifications/Experience Requirements:

  • Additional experience in supply chain, traffic, logistics, business is highly desired.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with a positive, team-oriented approach.
  • Ability to assess risk and recommend actions and strategies to mitigate regulatory risks.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently on multiple tasks to meet deadlines, prioritize, and maintain flexibility in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in tariff classification and country of origin determination. Engineering background in HTS Classification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of documentation requirements and Brazil Customs regulations.
  • Data analysis and Excel skills proficiency.
  • Brazil Customs Brokerage License not required, but highly desirable.
  • Impeccable ethics and trustworthiness.

Work Arrangement : Hybrid

We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

title: Senior Carbon Technical Manager
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY - Brazil, Mexico, Peru, Colombia, or Costa Rica

Amid growing consensus that the protection, restoration, and improved management of ecosystems can provide at least 30% of the climate mitigation needed to limit warming to 1.5°C, Conservation International (CI) has set ambitious targets to realize the potential of Natural Climate Solutions (NCS) worldwide. CI's Carbon Finance (CF) unit within the Nature Finance Group (NFG) invests in NCS that help combat climate change by reducing deforestation and conserving and restoring critical ecosystems. These NCS solutions include the protection, enhanced management, and restoration of forests, rangelands, wetlands, and other natural systems.

The Carbon Finance team works across CI field programs and partner organizations to source and finance a strong pipeline of high-quality NCS carbon projects coupled with innovative financing designed to ensure long-term sustainability and private sector participation. The team taps the deep knowledge and technical expertise within CI to catalyze and improve the quality of gigatons of emission reductions and removals in the voluntary and compliance carbon markets. The CF team prioritizes impact through community engagement and benefit-sharing, biodiversity and environmental benefits, and the application of safeguards.

The Senior Carbon Technical Manager is an integral part of the CF team. The Senior Manager will be responsible for supporting the due diligence, development, and delivery of a carbon portfolio of investable NCS site- and jurisdictional-scale initiatives. This involves assessing early-stage pipeline opportunities, conducting project scoping, feasibility, and due diligence, performing field visits, and moving priority opportunities to full-scale development, including oversight of Project Documents and Monitoring Reports. The Senior Manager is also responsible for guiding projects through the validation and verification processes for certification standards such as the VCS and CCB, Gold Standard, the Mexico Forest Protocol, or other domestic and jurisdictional standards. The position includes project and budget planning and management, tracking and reporting on deliverables and project status.

The individual will work closely with a diverse team of CI staff members from around the world to apply their field experience, scientific knowledge, research skills, and innovative tools to evaluate project opportunities and guide them through design, development and certification processes. This position does not directly supervise staff.

Responsibilities

Carbon Project Development

  • Work with CI’s Regional Carbon Leads to provide Carbon Finance technical review, input, and guidance for projects undergoing scoping and feasibility assessment, and contribute to reports related to this effort. This will require desktop review and technical analysis of relevant documentation regarding project design, as well as direct engagement with project entities and conducting due diligence field visits, where needed. Technical analysis might include aspects such as assessing the agents and drivers of deforestation, key carbon project eligibility concepts, carbon accounting, governance, safeguards, and benefit-sharing frameworks, as well as risk mitigation, business models, etc.
  • For selected projects, provide Carbon Finance team project management oversight of the scoping and feasibility process, working with CI field programs, partners, and service providers. Ensure project information, workplans and deliverables are developed, completed, and shared with all relevant stakeholders, monitor progress, ensure alignment of the process and outcomes with NFG’s criteria and process on high-quality carbon projects, and identify corrective actions to resolve problems and ensure future project efficiencies.
  • For selected projects, act as a Carbon Finance team lead on the management and delivery of Project Documents (PD), Monitoring Reports (MRs), and other related documentation to ensure achievement of project validation and verification processes. This includes providing project entities with support on work planning, technical input and review, monitoring and evaluation, and overseeing the work of consultants, Validation & Verification Bodies (VVBs), and other service providers.
  • Work closely with, coordinate, collaborate, and communicate with all institutional carbon-related staff & teams (field and global programs) to ensure alignment with CI’s NCS and carbon crediting strategies and priorities.

Due Diligence

  • Lead desktop due diligence of the NCS project and jurisdictional opportunities. Evaluate projected carbon outcomes from emissions reductions and removals (ERRs) models to ensure targets are achievable given context and carbon crediting requirements.
  • Lead field-level due diligence of the NCS project and jurisdictional opportunities. Evaluate projected ERRs to ensure achievable targets given site conditions, local context, partner capacity, and carbon crediting requirements. Provide recommendations for improvement and summarize findings in coherent and well-substantiated written reports that will be shared with internal and external partners.
  • Review Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) protocols for NCS projects and conduct annual monitoring of reported results, including field-level site visits as required.
  • Develop and maintain CI’s relationships with project partners, consultants, and investors to enhance collaboration and partnership initiatives by continually providing useful technical inputs and identifying new opportunities for achieving CI’s global objectives in NCS.

Technical Innovation

  • Support the development of carbon and GIS tools, frameworks, and templates to streamline data gathering, analysis, and narrative elements of feasibility assessments, due diligence reports, PDs and MRs, including but not limited to emissions reduction or removal models, biodiversity and community monitoring, stakeholder engagement, workplans, theory of change models etc.
  • Provide technical assessment and comment on carbon market standards and methodology reviews that the Carbon Finance team will lead.
  • Support carbon project development training for CI countries, projects, and partners on a needs assessment basis.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This is a full-time position. Work will be performed in a typical office environment, with potential for work from a home office.
  • Frequent travel within the Latin America region (and globally) will be required and will consist of approximately ~30% of the person’s time, often this will entail travel to remote locations with rustic conditions.
  • Flexibility in work schedule is required to accommodate time differences between the Arlington, VA office and international field offices in multiple time zones.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in forest management, forest ecology, natural resource management, climate science, or related fields.
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working on the technical development or due diligence of NCS projects.
  • Demonstrated experience with the application of NCS carbon accounting approaches and methodologies, including, but not limited to:
  • determining baseline and project emissions reductions & removals.
  • evaluating robustness of additionality arguments, non-permanence risk assessments, leakage estimates, and “business as usual” scenarios.
  • confirming the suitability of allometric equations, Biomass Expansion Factors, volumetric growth rate, wood density, root-to-shoot ratio, carbon fraction, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience with the validation and verification of NCS crediting projects (VCS, Gold Standard, CCBS, etc.), including the development of Project Documents (PDs), Monitoring Reports (MRs), and Validation and Verification Body (VVB) audits.
  • Excellent project management and coordination skills, and a strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent analytical skills with demonstrable experience in GIS, and Remote Sensing, including land-use change modeling.
  • Successful track record working with diverse team members, clients, stakeholders, and partners from different economic, cultural, religious, gender, and professional backgrounds in a range of countries or geographic contexts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience working with local partners, with an understanding of the on-the-ground realities and challenges of project development and delivery.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, multitask, set priorities, and deliver quality results.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to build on existing knowledge to develop new approaches.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in a relevant field.
  • Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.
  • Demonstrated field-level experience in forest conservation, restoration of native ecosystems, improved forest management, or natural resource management.
  • Experience with training field teams on developing and implementing forest, carbon, and biodiversity monitoring plans.
  • Experience in carbon accounting for soils (e.g., peatlands, wetlands, and rangelands).
  • Experience communicating about REDD+ and other forest carbon finance mechanisms to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with or within the private sector on climate and NCS-related issues.
  • Experience working with indigenous peoples and traditional communities.
  • Experience working with government partners and supporting the development of policy.
  • Experience communicating about NCS and carbon finance mechanisms to technical and non-technical audiences.

description:
place Oslo, Norway

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field
What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

O estagiário atuará no canteiro de obras, prestando suporte à equipe de engenharia na fiscalização da execução de serviços, controle de qualidade, medição de materiais e acompanhamento do cronograma físico-financeiro. As responsabilidades incluirão a elaboração de diários de obra, verificação de conformidade com projetos e especificações, registro fotográfico do avanço da obra e auxílio na organização do canteiro. Será uma oportunidade valiosa para entender a logística de construção, a segurança do trabalho e a resolução de problemas práticos no dia a dia da obra.

Requisitos

Estar Cursando Engenharia Civil na faculdade: Este é o pré-requisito fundamental. Geralmente, as vagas de estágio exigem que o estudante esteja a partir do 4º semestre da graduação, embora algumas possam aceitar estudantes mais no início ou mais no final do curso.

Vínculo com a Instituição de Ensino: É imprescindível que o estágio seja formalizado através de um Termo de Compromisso de Estágio (TCE), assinado pela empresa, pelo estudante e pela instituição de ensino. Este documento garante que o estágio esteja em conformidade com a Lei do Estágio (Lei nº 11.788/2008), que regulamenta a atividade no Brasil.

Plano de Atividades: Um plano detalhado das atividades que serão desenvolvidas durante o estágio, também aprovado pela faculdade e pela empresa, é obrigatório.

Seguro Contra Acidentes Pessoais: A empresa contratante deve providenciar um seguro que cubra acidentes pessoais para o estagiário durante o período do estágio.

Disponibilidade de Horário: A carga horária máxima permitida por lei é de 6 horas diárias e 30 horas semanais durante o período letivo. Durante as férias acadêmicas, pode ser estendida para 40 horas semanais. É importante que não haja conflito com os horários de aula.

Desde 1948, a Andrade Gutierrez vem ajudando a construir e a desenvolver o Brasil. Desde então, a empresa tem participado de algumas das obras mais importantes da história de nosso país.   • Collaborate with other Project Specialists and Designers.
  • Coordinate and review technical activities performed internally and externally to ensure compliance with technical requirements and adherence to established deadlines.
  • Create and propose process improvements, as well as provide technical assistance and guide the team
  • Requiring understanding of a concepts, methods, and procedures

A CIBT oferece um conjunto abrangente de serviços sob duas marcas principais: a Newland Chase, uma subsidiária integral focada em estratégia de imigração global e serviços de consultoria para empresas em todo o mundo, e a CIBTvisas, líder de mercado em serviços de vistos de negócios e outros vistos de viagem para clientes corporativos e particulares. title: Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining EngineeringJoin or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

VEM SER NATURAL DA TERRA!

Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa.
Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria.

Todos os dias acordamos com um único objetivo: promover uma vida mais natural – em todos os sentidos.
Se você também acredita nesse propósito, vem com a gente!

Realizar a limpeza e conservação de peixes e frutos do mar preparando variadas refeições da cozinha oriental, conforme sortimento da empresa, verificando e garantindo a qualidade, frescor, aparência, exposição e organização da área de vendas para atendimento dos nossos clientes.

• Realizar a higienização do local de armazenamento, garantir o correto acondicionamento das mercadorias e verificar a qualidade e validade dos itens em estoque
• Seguir as normas estabelecidas pela Vigilância Sanitária e Manual de Boas Práticas

REQUISITOS:
• Ensino fundamental completo
• Experiência Anterior

INCLUSÃO E DIVERSIDADE
Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Alimentação no local

Plano de saúde

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil.

Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável.

Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas espalhadas por 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG).
Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras podem ser realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas.
Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas.

O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois!

Nossa Missão:
Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil.

Nossos Valores são:
• Jogo aberto e íntegro
• Foco em resultado com qualidade
• Trabalho em equipe compartilhando o sucesso
• Excelência no Atendimento
• Jeito simples e alegre de ser
• Atitude Responsável

Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família!

Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo.

Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e toda a diversidade em relação a raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais é importante e será muito bem-vinda.

  • As Operations Technical Autority, you provide Regional Ownership and accountability of fleet Safety and Environmentally Critical Element (SECE) Performance Standards within their discipline. You act as part of the local Technical Team in assuring the status of the SECE within your scope.
Responsibilities
  • You travel to all units within your scope at least twice a year to maintain a strong connection with front-line operations.
  • You provide independent technical advice to regional personnel, ensuring clarity and confidence in operational decisions.
  • You act as the technical liaison between your discipline, the Operations Risk Team, and subject-matter experts.

Job description for Offshore Planner position

Onshore Planning Lead (functionally)


Background: This position will be responsible for the look ahead and ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements. They are the owner of 14 and 28 days look ahead.

Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment.
Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues, external visitors and supervisors.
Carry out accurate and effective work handovers.

Responsible for reviewing & prioritizing all corrective work requests with the work team to ensure corrective work order priorities are properly assigned.

3) Control of Works
Offshore owner of 14 and 28 days plan lookahead, ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements.
Monitor weekly execution progress
When required develop work plans for maintenance jobs with necessary information to allow efficient scheduling, assignment, and execution of maintenance work.
Perform site readiness check and validate the appropriate job work scope with the offshore disciplines and feedback to onshore unit planner.
Monitor Maintenance KPIs and performances, warn support team of any recurring problems related to the maintenance activity back log.
Suggests improvements and requests modifications for planning and for the CMMS and Work Order flow chart.

4) Management of Conditions, Behaviours and Events
Contribute to the continued improvement and implementation of the best practices in the planning discipline.
Review CMMS reporting are done efficiently and correctly. Equally, help with CMMS activities such as correction of Notifications, upload activities report under CMMS, and so on.

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience

Degree in relevant technical or business discipline or can be substituted by suitable industry experience.
Extensive experience as a maintenance planner or Supervisor in oil and gas upstream industries.
A basic knowledge of the process of oil and gas treatment, installations and a thorough knowledge of the equipment used in oil and gas treatment installations.
Experience in Planning software (primavera P6) and CMMS (IFS) and electronic Permit-to-Work systems.
Proficiency in English at a minimum of B1 level according to the CEFR international standard.

title: Srum Master
description:
Que tal fazer parte do nosso time como Scrum Master?

Sua missão será atuar como facilitador da cultura ágil, promovendo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de projetos e uso adequado de ferramentas utilizadas. Você apoiará as equipes na avaliação de demandas e recursos, acompanhará KPIs e OKRs, e atuará de forma consultiva junto a Product Owners e lideranças.

Essa é uma oportunidade no modelo híbrido no Rio de Janeiro.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Como Scrum Master, você focará em:

  • Avaliar junto as gerências técnicas as demandas, viabilidade, alocação de recursos e cronogramas estratégicos.
  • Estabelecer e manter os padrões de gestão de projetos e métodos ágeis (Scrum, PMBOK etc.).
  • Garantir a utilização adequada das ferramentas (Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, GANTT CHART).
  • Implantar e monitorar KPIs e OKRs da área, promovendo gestão baseada em dados.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e proativa junto aos Product Owners e líderes de tecnologia.
  • Promover iniciativas de inovação e transformação digital.
  • Buscar tendências, ferramentas e boas práticas de mercado aplicáveis à realidade da empresa.
  • Avaliar oportunidades de automação, inteligência de dados e eficiência operacional.
  • Estimular cultura de colaboração, autonomia, melhoria contínua e aprendizado.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Como requisitos básicos, buscamos:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos ágeis, preferencialmente Azure DevOps.
  • Conhecimento prático dos frameworks Scrum.
  • Vivência em Gestão de Projetos tradicional.
  • Capacidade de criar e interpretar métricas de desempenho ágil (burnup, burndown, velocity).
  • Certificação Scrum Master (CSM, PSM I ou equivalente).
  • Experiência com indicadores de performance.

Você se destaca se tiver:

  • Experiência no sistema Service Now.
  • Experiência com projetos de alta complexidade.
  • Certificações adicionais (Kanban KMP, SAFe, PMI-ACP).
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps.
  • Experiência em processos de transformação ágil em grandes organizações.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

O que você irá encontrar por aqui?

Acreditamos que um bom profissional, antes de tudo, é uma pessoa que cuida do seu corpo e da sua mente. E, para isso, você poderá contar com alguns benefícios como:

  • Plano de saúde (nosso plano possui uma excelente cobertura e você irá contribuir com apenas 20% do valor - sem coparticipação)
  • Plano odontológico (o valor fica por nossa conta!)
  • Caju: vale refeição/alimentação flexível
  • Totalpass: Auxílio a academia
  • Seguro de vida
  • 8 days off por ano

Apoiamos também a busca pela excelência no conhecimento e nossos Bridge’s contam com alguns incentivos:

  • Descontos em certificações com instituições parceiras
  • Plataforma interna de treinamentos com assuntos de diversas áreas de conhecimento
  • Canais internos de troca de conhecimento

Valorizamos a nossa gente diariamente proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho pautado em nossos valores. Acreditamos que todos possuem um papel de extrema importância em nossa trajetória. Somos uma empresa, mas somos feitos de pessoas.

Aqui, unimos visão analítica e parceria com o time comercial para decisões assertivas.

We are seeking a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Engineer to join its Inspection Technology Unit (ITU) within the Inspection Technical Support Division.

The ITU is responsible for the development and deployment of advanced inspection technologies to ensure asset integrity across upstream and downstream operations. The unit focuses on qualifying and implementing innovative solutions—particularly In-Line Inspection (ILI) systems—to improve pipeline safety, reliability, and cost efficiency.

As a Non-Destructive Testing Engineer, your primary role is to lead the evaluation and implementation of NDT technologies, especially ILI systems, to enhance pipeline integrity strategies.

Duties and Responsibilities

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Evaluate emerging NDT and ILI technologies
  • Provide technical guidance on application, and support their deployment across pipeline operations.
  • Oversee the technical performance of ILI tools in the field
  • Collaborate with vendors to improve data quality and tool capabilities
  • Assist in validating inspection results through field verification and integration with inspection programs.
  • Promote the adoption of advanced inspection methodologies to detect and manage critical pipeline anomalies such as corrosion, cracking, and geometry defects, ensuring alignment with safety, compliance, and operational excellence standards.

As the successful candidate you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering. Advance degree is highly desirable.
  • Minimum of 20 years of professional experience in asset inspection and non-destructive testing technologies, including hands-on involvement in inline inspection operations and data interpretation.
  • NDT Level III certification in at least two inspection methods.
  • Ability to apply international codes and standards relevant to inspection operations, such as API, ASME, and AWS.
  • Ability to demonstrate a strong understanding of pipeline inspection principles, including pigging operations, pipeline cleaning, and inline inspection tool validation techniques.
  • Experience identifying and analyzing damage mechanisms detected via inline inspection, such as corrosion, stress corrosion cracking, weld anomalies, dents, and cracks.
  • Familiar with high-resolution inspection technologies used in inline tools, including magnetic flux leakage, ultrasonic testing, and electromagnetic acoustic transducer systems.
  • Capability to analyze inline inspection results and provide technical support for run/rerun decisions, dig verification campaigns, and fitness-for-service assessments.
  • Knowledge of AI and machine learning integration for predictive pipeline integrity assessments is preferred.
  • Proficiency in interpreting inspection data using advanced analytics software.
  • Ability demonstrates strong economic analysis, planning, and budgeting skills to support inspection strategy development and implementation.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer II
description:
15 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects

Nossa Cultura Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Sênior Data Scientist

Apoiar decisões estratégicas de negócio através de experimentos com rigor estatístico , tanto no online quanto no offline (agentes comerciais, polos, canais).

Responsabilidades

  • Definir e executar A/B tests, multivariados e quasi-experimentos;
  • Criar metodologias robustas para experimentos offline (polos comerciais);
  • Desenvolver frameworks para simulação e análise de poder estatístico;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com PMs e engenheiros na evolução da plataforma de experimentação;
  • Garantir comunicação clara dos resultados para stakeholders executivos.

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Forte background em estatística e design de experimentos (DOE, causal inference);
  • Experiência prática com A/B testing e experimentos em larga escala;
  • Fluência em Python ou R para análise estatística;
  • Vivência em ferramentas de experimentação (Amplitude, Growthbook, VWO);
  • Capacidade de traduzir resultados técnicos em impacto de negócio;

O Que Aumenta Suas Chances

  • Experiência em experimentação offline;
  • Experiência em modelos quasi-experimentais (dif-in-dif, propensity score matching).

title: Interpretation Geophysicist
description:
Join to apply for the Interpretation Geophysicist role at Viridien .

Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Key Responsibilities
  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.
About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications
  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.
Benefits
  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Voucher
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu Therapy at the Office
  • TotalPass Fitness Program
  • Hybrid Work Model (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Birthday Day Off
  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.
Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. We may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant due to high application volumes. Candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview, and we aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round and beyond. (Isso inclui revisar e compilar a parte técnica do pacote de licitação com base nas informações recebidas dos técnicos e fornecer aconselhamento comercial relevante).

O titular do cargo segue as regras de H3SE:

  • Manter os meios de proteção individual e os procedimentos de emergência de segurança.

  • Conduzir o trabalho de maneira a otimizar o desempenho em HSEQ (Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade), a reputação e a lucratividade da Empresa, em estrita conformidade com os mais altos padrões de ética empresarial.
  • Estar em conformidade com os requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Empresa (CMS) aplicáveis ao cargo, reportando quaisquer não conformidades à gestão direta.

O titular do cargo deverá garantir que:

  • As regras da Empresa sejam seguidas ou devidamente justificadas em caso de exceção.
  • As Especificações Gerais, Diretrizes e Manuais sejam considerados.

  • Sejam buscadas oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência.
Perfil do candidato

Competências de C&P (Contratos e Compras):

  • Competências técnicas avançadas em contratos e compras são exigidas.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado nas demais competências técnicas.

  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência prática na preparação, negociação e administração de contratos de projetos complexos, preferencialmente na indústria de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimento profissional demonstrável e compreensão de questões comerciais, jurídicas e de seguros que afetam a empresa em geral, e compreensão aprofundada quando relevante para contratos de obras, bens e serviços.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

description:
